title: Elastic column layouts and scrolling affordances for very tall virtualized tables
creator: Ava Kline
description: Problem statement: Current virtualized table behaviour does not gracefully handle a mix of extremely wide and extremely narrow columns at large scale (10k+ rows). Users report awkward horizontal scrolling, frequent need for manual column resizing, and density presets that either waste vertical space or make rows unreadably tight. This ticket scopes a design solution for: (1) elastic column layout modes that compress low-priority columns when viewport width is constrained; (2) improved scrolling affordances and sticky visual guides for a better sense of position in very tall lists; (3) a clearer density system with an adaptive density toggle for limited-viewport height use cases; and (4) accessible resize and sort/filter interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Design mockups for three density modes (Comfort, Compact, Dense) with defined token values for row height, vertical padding, and type scales
Elastic column algorithm spec: priority weighting, min/max column widths, and rule for compression vs. overflow
Prototypes (Figma prototype + small HTML/CSS prototype) demonstrating double-click autosize, shift-drag proportional resize, and keyboard resize handles
Scroll affordance patterns: sticky column headers, viewport position indicator for extremely tall tables, and a lightweight mini-map option documented
Sorting/filtering UX: persistent filter chips area, multi-column sort UI, keyboard-accessible filter editor, and clear empty-state guidance
Performance targets annotated on designs: continuous 60 FPS scroll in virtualized lists up to 20k rows with default batch/windowing parameters
Accessibility checklist satisfied: focus order, aria-labels for resize grips, contrast for sticky indicators, and screen-reader description for density toggle
design_decisions: Prefer compression over horizontal scrolling when a majority of identifiable columns are low-priority; leave primary identifier columns fixed and never compressed below 80px
Introduce a column-priority attribute in the table schema (low/medium/high) surfaced in Console and allowed as defaults in table components
Density toggle will expose three presets and an auto mode that reduces density when visible viewport height < 400px or when user selects a 'maximize rows' preference
Double-click on column gutter will autosize to measured content width up to a max cap; Ctrl/Cmd + double-click will autosize all columns
Mini-map is optional and off by default; enabled in Console settings per route for datasets > 5k rows
Keyboard resizing uses left/right arrow with modifier to nudge columns by 4px; long-press accelerates
